name: buyme-acoffee

frames.best_why: The full coffee-script pattern and centred cup tile are both visible, cleanly framed with no cursor.

tagline: Coffee cup badge that turns into a yellow 'Buy me a coffee' card on hover.
summary: A tiled cream card covered in handwritten 'coffee' script with a yellow cup tile at centre; hovering clears the pattern to a yellow card reading 'Buy me a coffee' with a heart and bigger cup.
appearance: A square cream card filled edge to edge with black handwritten 'coffee' script in a loose repeating pattern. At its centre sits a white rounded tile holding a yellow square, inside which a black-outlined takeaway coffee cup stands upright.
behaviour: Hovering wipes the script pattern away, shrinking it to reveal a yellow card with a small pink heart sticker, a larger coffee cup and hand-lettered 'Buy me a coffee' across the top. Moving away restores the patterned cover.
demo_content: Text repeats 'coffee'; the hover card reads 'Buy me a coffee'.
use_when: A creator or indie page wants a playful, obvious link for visitors to leave a tip.
avoid_when: The large patterned card is bold and branded; it dominates a layout and clashes with muted palettes.
customise: Three className props let you restyle the card, icon and text layers; the SVG coffee artwork, link URL and palette live in the file and need editing.
weight_why: A large inline SVG and CSS transform transitions; no script loop.

a11y.note: The link's artwork is SVG with no accessible name or alt, so it announces as an unlabeled link; the hover swap ignores prefers-reduced-motion.

issues: The link has no text or aria-label, so its purpose is invisible to screen readers.
The hover-only swap means touch users only ever see the patterned cover.
polish_why: Distinctive hand-drawn art and a fun reveal; hover-only second state and unlabeled link are flaws.
